name: influencer.picture_due
description: The Instagram accounts the server's picture fetch (packages/connect, roster-pictures.ts) reads next, oldest first, at most limit: the roster's (by person id and handle) and the brands' saved Instagram collaborators no one on the roster holds (by company and handle), each with a handle Instagram takes, never read or not for 30 days. Internal.
sql:
select d.result from (
  select jsonb_build_object('id', a.influencer_id, 'handle', a.handle) as result, a.read_at as at, a.handle
  from brandbase.influencer_accounts a
  where a.platform = 'instagram' and a.handle ~ '^[a-z0-9._]{1,30}$'
  union all
  select jsonb_build_object('org', s.org_id, 'handle', s.handle), max(p.read_at), s.handle
  from (
    select distinct b.org_id, lower(regexp_replace(btrim(e.v), '^@+', '')) as handle
    from brandbase.brands b, jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(b.collaborators -> 'ig', '[]'::jsonb)) as e(v)
  ) s
  left join brandbase.account_profiles p on p.org_id = s.org_id and p.handle = s.handle
  where s.handle ~ '^[a-z0-9._]{1,30}$'
    and not exists (select 1 from brandbase.influencer_accounts x where x.org_id = s.org_id and x.platform = 'instagram' and x.handle = s.handle)
  group by s.org_id, s.handle
) d
where d.at is null or d.at < :now::timestamptz - interval '30 days'
order by d.at nulls first, d.handle
limit :limit::int
